newsitem.title: HONDURAS: HONDURAS INFLATION UP 1.4 PCT IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: HONDURAS INFLATION UP 1.4 PCT IN JULY.

text.p: Honduran inflation climbed 1.4 percent in July, bringing cumulative inflation for the year to 10.2 percent, the central bank said on Wednesday.
In June, the consumer price index rose 1.3 percent.

Increases in the price of food was mainly responsible for the July rise, central bank president Hugo Pino said, adding the country was on course to reach its 16 percent year-end inflation target. ((--Honduras bureau +504 327 898))
